metadata.title: Palantir Stock Is Ready to Rise After Lackluster 2026, Says J.P. Morgan<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why J.P. Morgan Believes Palantir Stock Is Just Getting Going After a Lackluster 2026
Shares of Palantir Technologies have been lackluster, by their standards, this year even as the company has experienced robust sales growth. J.P. Morgan believes that could change soon.
